events.region: Western Kiowa County; Eastern Kiowa County; Las Animas Vicinity/Bent County; Lamar Vicinity/Prowers County
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
At 1035 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm 8
miles north of Hasty, or 21 miles northwest of Lamar, moving
southeast at 10 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts of 50 to 55 mph and nickel size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor hail damage to vegetation is
possible.

Locations impacted include...
Neeoshe Reservoir, McClave, Hasty, Neegronda Reservoir, and
Sweetwater Reservoir.

events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
At 933 PM MST, local law enforcement flash flooding in the warned
area. Between 1 and 2 inches of rain have fallen. Flash flooding is
occuring along Ocotillo Road north of Benson.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Law enforcement reported.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Benson and Mescal.

This includes the following highways...
Route 90 near mile marker 290. Interstate 10 between mile markers 297
and 304.

This includes the following streams and drainages...
Ash Creek, Mescal Arroyo, Cadillac Wash, Pacheco Wash and San Pedro
River.
